objective: Required analytic area sensitivities and a separate smooth linear acquisition operator toward five-parameter geometry recovery; not recovery or physical qualification itself.

geometry_family.material: disk(C,R) intersect m dot (x-C)<=f*R; m is the exact represented canonicalized normal from finite_aperture
geometry_family.angle: continuous rotation of stored m at its fixed exact norm; not derivative of binary64 input canonicalization
geometry_family.source_grid: same exact represented origin/pitch local-cell bounds as finite_aperture
geometry_family.boundary_method: all exposed circle intervals plus closing chord flux; exact surd event equality, rational chord slabs, 96-digit decimal event coordinates/moments, binary64 atan2/trigonometry/output
geometry_family.unknown_policy: positive-length chord/cell-side coincidence is nondifferentiable; fraction endpoints explicitly withheld; unresolved event separation/classification/intersection remains unknown; NaN internal unknowns serialize only as null with status

population.rule: All authored cases and all failed/unknown reference or candidate outcomes retained. No population, tolerance or source changes after execution without separate admitted continuation.
population.definition: Every fixed case in regular_cases(), grid_cases() and special_cases(), frozen with the complete runner before execution

linear_operator.map: A=ordered queries * post correlation * signed Keys * optical correlation; no float32 casts or encoding
linear_operator.channels: 1..6 signed finite caller fields plus one explicitly charged constant channel; coverage+five derivatives supported together
linear_operator.brightness: two-column basis [A1-Ac,Ac], preserving raw supplied kernel sums
linear_operator.work: D*[N*(1+Ko)+M*(16+Kp)], D=C+1; separately bounded coefficient preparation, validation and hashing
linear_operator.qualification: fixed independent exact/decimal and explicit border/interpolation controls in tests/test_finite_acquisition_linear.py; six-channel linearity, cancellation, raw coefficient sums, input/hash isolation, resource refusals and immutable outputs
linear_operator.rounding_comparator: finite_acquisition remains unchanged; no equivalence to smooth derivatives or source-code quantization intervals asserted
linear_operator.coupled_controls: tests/test_finite_acquisition_sensitivity.py checks all five geometry-to-intensity columns by separate perturbed-area means, zero-contrast nonidentifiability and rejection of unknown cell derivatives

resources.aperture_work: one complete source-cell evaluation per unit, maximum65536; not arithmetic or timing units
resources.workspace: explicit numeric bounds excluding Python/exact-number/allocator/caller overhead; not RSS guarantees
resources.error_estimates: engineering arithmetic estimates; not certified enclosures or physical uncertainty
resources.decimal_moment_relative_refusal: positive chord length <=1e-90/(64*2**-52) is withheld; absolute moment allowances also propagate to each derivative column

execution.reference_independence: positive vertical-slice integration and boundary GL quadrature do not call Green-area or candidate helpers

remaining_goal_requirements: prospectively checked geometry recovery in five parameters with observation-derived seeds/bounds
explicit treatment of nonsmooth coincidences, float32 and source encoding
source assumptions/camera calibration and projective support
reserved independent dimensions and real-camera/caliper checks
one accepted boundary preserved through preview/native CAD/exports

primary_sources.use: Boundary-flux differentiation after prefiltering; erratum requires arc-length measure dp or norm(p prime)dt. Own closed-form disk/chord derivation, not a DiffVG implementation.
